import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, mix, color } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry } = ctx.THREE;

  // Root container
  const rootGroup = new Group();

  // Color Palette extraction
  const colors = config.colors ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  // --- STAGE BACKDROP (Fills the scene grid to prevent flat black voids) ---
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(10, 8);
  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ depthWrite: false });
  
  // High-contrast vertical gradient (ink base with surface top glow)
  const topCol = color(colors.surface);
  const botCol = color(colors.ink);
  backdropMat.colorNode = mix(botCol, topCol, uv().y);

  const backdrop = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdrop.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  rootGroup.add(backdrop);

  // --- SPRITE CARD ---
  // Sized intentionally based on the 512x320 atlas aspect ratio (1.6)
  const cardWidth = 3.2;
  const cardHeight = 2.0;
  const spriteGeo = new PlaneGeometry(cardWidth, cardHeight);
  
  const spriteMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: true,
    opacity: 0.0 // Managed by entrance animation
  });

  const spriteMesh = new Mesh(spriteGeo, spriteMat);
  spriteMesh.position.set(0, 0, 0.1);
  rootGroup.add(spriteMesh);

  // Load and map image texture
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((texture) => {
      spriteMat.colorNode = texture;
      spriteMat.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn('Failed to load sprite texture:', err);
    });
  }

  // --- INTRO & IDLE ANIMATIONS ---
  const entryTimeline = gsap.timeline();
  
  // Refined entrance curve (rise-in / settle style)
  entryTimeline.fromTo(spriteMesh.position, 
    { y: -0.25 },
    { y: 0, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power3.out' }
  );
  entryTimeline.fromTo(spriteMat, 
    { opacity: 0 },
    { opacity: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out' },
    '<0.1'
  );

  // Smooth micro-hover breathing cycle
  const idleTween = gsap.to(spriteMesh.position, {
    y: '+=0.04',
    duration: 3.5,
    repeat: -1,
    yoyo: true,
    ease: 'power1.inOut',
    delay: 0.9
  });

  // --- CLEANUP INTERFACE ---
  rootGroup.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup() {
      // Terminate animations
      entryTimeline.kill();
      idleTween.kill();
      // Dispose GPU entities
      backdropGeo.dispose();
      backdropMat.dispose();
      spriteGeo.dispose();
      spriteMat.dispose();
    }
  };

  return rootGroup;
}
